mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% does not lead to negative 20-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in the last 3 months signals a strengthening labor market, boosting consumer confidence and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE decreases > 0.5% in 3 months does not lead to positive 60-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over 3 consecutive months signals a strengthening demand in the housing market, which is a leading indicator of economic growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST increases over 3 consecutive months but does not lead to positive 20-day forward returns in > 50% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in the last month signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO decreases > 1% in 1 month does not lead to negative 5-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) grow faster than GDP (GDPC1) over the last quarter, it signals strong consumer demand, which is a positive indicator for S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS growth > GDPC1 growth in last quarter
failure_condition: If RSAFS growth > GDPC1 growth in the last quarter does not lead to positive 20-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 in the last month, coupled with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE), signals a robust labor market, boosting economic sentiment and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS increases > 200,000 & UNRATE decreases but does not lead to positive 20-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 25 basis points in the last month signals an accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS decreases > 25bps in 1 month does not lead to positive 60-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP (GDPC1) over two consecutive quarters signals strong economic growth, which is a positive indicator for S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 increases over two consecutive quarters but does not lead to positive 60-day forward returns in > 50% of instances.
